shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,260p' app/lib/auth.ts && sed -n '1,260p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "test -d node_modules && echo installed || echo not-installed
rg -n \"authInterrupts|function forbidden|export.*forbidden|Forbidden\" node_modules/next -g '*.{d.ts,js,mjs}' | sed -n '1,240p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next.config.ts app/admin/page.tsx app/admin/admin.module.css app/forbidden.tsx app/forbidden.module.css && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false'

/bin/bash -lc "curl --silent --show-error --dump-header /tmp/admin-headers.txt --output /tmp/admin-body.html http://127.0.0.1:3107/admin
sed -n '1,30p' /tmp/admin-headers.txt
rg -o \"This area is for admins only\\.|403["'^<]{0,40}|Return home|Access was safely blocked" /tmp/admin-body.html | sort -u'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,220p' app/admin/page.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' app/forbidden.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "curl --silent --show-error --write-out 'status=%{http_code}\\n' --output /tmp/admin-body-final.html http://127.0.0.1:3107/admin
rg -o \"This area is for admins only\\.|Return home|Access was safely blocked\" /tmp/admin-body-final.html | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && rg -n \"forbidden\\(|authInterrupts|verifyAdmin|This area is for admins only\" app next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/admin/page.tsx | sed -n '1,140p'
nl -ba app/forbidden.tsx | sed -n '1,120p'
nl -ba next.config.ts | sed -n '1,80p'
nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"
